views.front: Smooth stored cable loops and the connected holster lead make the compact wall charger read as an assembled device.
views.rear: Rear cable arcs remain continuous and the original mounting enclosure is intact; cable storage stays stylized at this catalog scale.
views.detail: The former loose cable ends now meet the stored loops, with rounded transitions into the case and connector holster.
views.underside: The underside view shows seated case and holster connections with no dangling disconnected short tail.
views.clay: The clay view confirms clean closed winding contours and improved lead contact while retaining the original charger silhouette.
